svg.title: Hoi, I’m Simon. Developer. Tinkerer. Mountain person.
svg.desc: Animated alpine night: under a citron aurora, Simon carves down a snowy slope while a penguin in ski goggles slides after him. A typed line cycles through: building a Dynamic Island for Spotify; modding Minecraft with Fabric; teaching AI agents good design; crafting websites in Three.js & GSAP; probably on the slopes right now.
